props.name: beforeSubmit
props.description:
If given, this function is called before the `submit` event is emitted.

Optionally this callback may return `FValidationFormAction`. If
`FValidationFormAction.CANCEL` is returned the submission is
cancelled and no event will be emitted. The consumer should make it
clear why the action was cancelled.

If a promise is returned it will be awaited.

The consumer does not need to validate form data, it is handled
internally by the component.

props.name: beforeValidation
props.description: If given, this function is called before the form data is validated and the `submit` event is emitted.

props.name: id
props.description:
The id for the form id attribute.
If the prop is not set a random value will be generated.

props.name: errorListBeforeNavigate
props.description: Optional callback function to the error list component for performing actions before navigation.

events.name: submit
events.description: Emitted when form is successfully submitted.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Slot for content, i.e. input elements.
